name: testmail.app Essential for Students
benefit: Free Essential plan during eligible studies with up to 10,000 test emails per month, full API access and 1–3 day message retention.
eligibility: Verified active students redeem the Essential plan through GitHub Student Developer Pack.
duration: While the user remains an eligible student under the partner offer.
restrictions: A single random namespace and limited message retention apply. Not the same as the provider's separate ongoing Free plan (100 emails/month).
